intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Troy for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events. Troy Historic Village's Cocoa and Crafts with Santa runs December 5 and 6, alongside the Stine Park tree lighting, Polar Party and brunch with Santa at Fogo de Chao. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Troy

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Troy
  • Meet Santa: Cocoa and Crafts with Santa (December 5 and 6), brunch with Santa
  • Tree lighting: Annual Holiday Tree Lighting at Stine Park
  • Season: December 5 and 6 for the new event

Planning a bigger day out? Troy families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Detroit, which covers the Detroit Historical Museum, the Greenfield Village railroad and Detroit's other holiday outings.
